notes: Kadiran Dam’s 2.56 km mapped regulating crest, concrete spillway and rust-painted gate works, crest road with curved lamps, the mapped powerhouse, its service apron and the adjacent tailrace. The five modeled spillway bays are an exterior interpretation of the photographed works. Exact bay count and gate operation remain unconfirmed. The powerhouse footprint is mapped. Its roof height, window layout, paved apron, and tailrace portals are exterior approximations fitted to the standard terrain and waterways. The separate downstream bridge and service roads remain native. Operating equipment and interiors are outside the exterior asset.
